inputs.proposal: Branch reparenting, child/leaf split, connected approximate spectral and spatial bisections generated from current regions, saved-partition hints, original-vertex moves.
inputs.scope: All original full-grid vertices; no city-specific rule or immutable community atoms.
inputs.selection: Per-policy, per-target absolute capture error bounded by canonical error + epsilon; minimise squared excess until feasible, then maximise sum of same-target Q. Nesting and all region floors always hard.
inputs.geography: Rook-adjacent ancestry changes; source component counts and total excess components cannot increase. Existing disconnected pieces may move with their original child region.
inputs.limitation: Heuristic; failure to find a feasible hierarchy does not prove infeasibility.

manifest.method: Canonical initial partitions; hard per-target Q >= canonical; each policy absolute error <= canonical; each canonical region AND each fixed municipality gross canonical internal OD cuts / its fixed outgoing <= budget. Region floors and spatial safeguards always hard.
manifest.objective: Lexicographic repeated-flip mass, downward internal-flow transitions, then sum of same-target Q. Quality-only paired control maximises Q with identical guards and proposals.
manifest.scope: All original cells and 17 targets, 2025 commute; no named-city intervention or forced nesting.

refinement.protocol: All 16 runs start from their saved 3-pass result and RNG state (labels densified on loading); one full nationwide adjacent-guide block sweep, including small disconnected remainder augmentation. No original-vertex or endogenous bisection sweep in refinement. All original hard guards and respective objectives preserved.

selection: Within each budget select the entire 17-level consistency run by least repeated-flip mass, least downward transitions, highest mean Q. Representative uses predeclared 2 pp; quality control uses the same seed. No targetwise splicing.
